verdict.rationale: The docs say budgets can cap spend per API key, as well as per team, project or member (docs-16). Keys are team-owned and usable from any environment (docs-40), and usage is broken down per API key (docs-12). That means an agent can get its own key with a hard spend cap. The pack has no evidence of per-key rate limits, so the 'rate guardrails' half of the story is unsupported. The budget evidence is also a single-line mention with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: per-key rate limiting, detailed budget-enforcement documentation (what happens when the cap is hit, reset periods), independent corroboration of per-key budgets working.
